sourceReferences.supports: Который agrees in gender and number with its antecedent, while its case is determined by its syntactic role in the subordinate clause. The genitive forms которого, которой, которых can mean whose and follow the possessed noun. Wade attests работу которого, владельцы которой, and родители которых in possessive relative clauses.
